# pve_storage_identity (Data Source)

Identity of a storage backend instance (unique id, sysfs/cluster identity info).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_storage_identity" "example" {
  node    = "pve1"
  storage = "local"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node name.
- `storage` (String) The storage identifier.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier: <node>/<storage>.
- `identity` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--identity))

<a id="nestedatt--identity"></a>
### Nested Schema for `identity`

Read-Only:

- `api_id` (String) Unique identifier for this storage instance. The exact format and semantics depend on the storage plugin type.
- `type` (String) The type of the storage.
